observations.title: Santa Maria volcano (Guatemala)
observations.description: The Instituto Nacional de Sismología, Vulcanología, Meteorología e Hidrología (INSIVUMEH) reported ongoing eruptive activity at Santa Maria?s Santiaguito dome complex during 7-14 October, with continuing lava extrusion at Caliente dome. Incandescence at the summit was observed during dark hours. Effusion of blocky lava and collapses of material produced daily incandescent block avalanches that descended the flanks, particularly the W, SW, and S flanks; during 7-8 and 11-12 October these collapses generated short pyroclastic flows that reached the base on the cone. Daily explosions, 0-3 per hour when reported, generated gas-and-ash plumes that rose as high as 1.1 km above the dome and drifted SW and W. On 7 October lahars descended the Nimá 1 drainage on the SW flank and the Tambor drainage on the SSW flank, carrying sediment, tree trunks, branches, and volcanic blocks up to 1 m in diameter. Ashfall was reported in Santa María de Jesús (5 km SE), the villages of Belén (10 km S) and Calaguache (9 km S), and other nearby communities during 7-8 October, in La Trinidad (13 km SSE), Santa Nita, Nueva Destina, Pawilonia, Rosario, and San Marcos Palajunoj (8 km SW) areas during 12-13 October, and in the mountainous area of the Monteclaro settlement and its surroundings during 13-14 October. Source: Instituto Nacional de Sismologia, Vulcanologia, Meteorologia, e Hidrologia (INSIVUMEH)
